rules.title: Indicator by 400 ms
rules.statement: Any pending agent response shows a visible indicator within 400 ms, a text status by 5 s, and elapsed time by 10 s.

detect.runtime: Timer-based DOM check for indicator, [data-status-text], [data-elapsed].

rules.title: No determinate bar without a denominator
rules.statement: No determinate progress bar without a known denominator.

detect.static: role="progressbar" requires aria-valuemax bound to a real count, else must be indeterminate.

rules.title: Stop inside the output region
rules.statement: Any stream longer than 1 s exposes a Stop control within the output region, not only in the composer.

detect.static: Stop target inside or adjacent to the streaming container, at least 32 by 32 px.

rules.title: No reflow beyond one line
rules.statement: Streaming must not reflow previously rendered content by more than one line height.

detect.runtime: Layout-shift measurement on the streamed region; CLS contribution below 0.05 per response.

rules.title: Auto-scroll yields to the user
rules.statement: Auto-scroll disengages on any user scroll-up and offers a jump-to-latest affordance.

detect.runtime: Scroll listener present; no programmatic scrollTo while userScrolled === true.

rules.title: Name the tool and its target
rules.statement: A tool call that takes more than 2 s shows its name and target (file, URL, query), not just a spinner.

detect.runtime: Tool card contains non-empty name and target text nodes before the 2 s mark.

rules.title: Writes look different from reads
rules.statement: Write and destructive tool calls are visually distinct from reads without expansion.

detect.static: Tool cards carry data-effect="read|write|destroy" mapped to distinct tokens.

rules.title: Per-action approval for destructive actions
rules.statement: Destructive agent actions (delete, send, pay, deploy, post, overwrite) require explicit per-action approval with a preview; "always allow" may not be the default option or initial focus.

detect.static: Approval dialog has a preview region; the default-focused button is not always-allow; no batch approval for data-effect="destroy".

rules.title: Verb, object and scope
rules.statement: Every approval prompt names verb, object and scope in its primary text.

detect.static: Regex on prompt title for a verb and a path, URL or identifier token.

rules.title: Undo or preview every write
rules.statement: Every agent write is undoable for at least 10 s or was previewed before apply.

detect.runtime: Each write emits an undo affordance or follows a diff-preview acceptance event.

rules.title: Keep the input, offer Retry
rules.statement: Every error state preserves the user's input and offers Retry.

detect.static: Error component contains a retry action; composer value unchanged after error.

rules.title: Cite retrieved claims
rules.statement: Claims rendered from retrieved sources carry an adjacent citation that links to the source.

detect.static: Retrieved spans have a sibling [data-cite] with href.

rules.title: Polite, throttled live regions
rules.statement: Streaming regions use aria-live="polite" and announce status changes at most once per 2 s.

detect.runtime: Live region present; no aria-live="assertive" on streams; throttled updates.

rules.title: Reduced motion branch
rules.statement: Thinking and streaming animations degrade under prefers-reduced-motion.

detect.static: Media query present; no transform-based looping animation in the reduced-motion branch.

rules.title: Never fake confidence
rules.statement: The interface never implies more certainty than the model expressed; hedges, uncertainty and refusals are shown as given, not smoothed over.

detect.static: No copy or styling upgrades a hedged or uncertain output to a definitive one; uncertainty is rendered where the backend reports it.

rules.title: Collapsed by default
rules.statement: Reasoning, tool detail and sources are collapsed by default behind a one-line summary; expanding is the user's choice.

detect.static: Collapsible defaults closed; a summary line stays visible while closed.

rules.title: Stop and regenerate always
rules.statement: Every generated message can be stopped while streaming and regenerated after it completes.

detect.static: A stop action is wired while status is streaming; a regenerate action is present on completed assistant messages.

rules.title: No AI purple
rules.statement: AI is not signaled with a new hue. --ai-accent is an alias of an existing brand token.

detect.static: No literal color in Lacquer code; --ai-accent resolves to a token the consumer already has.

rules.title: No bare sparkle
rules.statement: A sparkle or wand icon never stands alone as the only indication that content is AI; it is always paired with a visible text label.

detect.static: Any sparkle icon in a Lacquer component has an adjacent visible text label or an aria-label naming the AI origin.

rules.title: All five base states
rules.statement: Every interactive component implements enabled, hover, focus-visible, active and disabled with a defined visual treatment, including in dark mode.
rules.rationale: Most "the UI looks unfinished" complaints are missing states, not missing components.

detect.static: For each interactive element, the stylesheet or class list defines treatments for :hover, :focus-visible, :active and [disabled] / [aria-disabled].
detect.runtime: Drive each state and diff computed styles against the enabled state; each must differ in at least one property.

rules.fix: Add the missing state using the component's token deltas (see its states[] treatment).

rules.title: No state by colour alone
rules.statement: No state is expressed by colour alone; every state has a second channel (icon, weight, border, position or text).

detect.static: A state's class delta changes only color/background-color.
detect.runtime: Grayscale the screenshot of each state and check it still differs from enabled.

rules.fix: Add an icon, border, weight or text change alongside the colour change.

rules.title: Every state reaches the accessibility tree
rules.statement: Every visible state has an ARIA expression or an explicit "none" in the spec; selected, expanded, invalid, busy and current are never visual-only.

detect.static: For each state the component declares, the matching attribute (aria-selected, aria-expanded, aria-invalid, aria-busy, aria-current, aria-checked) is present when the state is active.

rules.fix: Set the attribute the APG pattern specifies; do not invent a new one.

rules.title: Never remove focus without replacing it
rules.statement: No `outline: none` / `outline-0` / `focus:outline-none` without a `:focus-visible` replacement that has ≥3:1 contrast against both the component and the page.

detect.static: Class or style removes outline and no focus-visible ring class/rule exists on the same element.
detect.runtime: Tab to the element; the focused and unfocused screenshots must differ at ≥3:1 along the element's edge.

rules.fix: Use `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-2` (or the binding's equivalent) and keep `:focus` untouched.

rules.title: Native element first
rules.statement: Prefer the native element (button, a, select, details, input) until a product requirement makes it impossible; a div or span with a click handler and a role is a defect unless the spec names an exception.

detect.static: div|span with onClick/onKeyDown and no native equivalent in the subtree.

rules.fix: Replace with the native element; keep the styling.

rules.title: Every control has an accessible name
rules.statement: Every interactive element has an accessible name from content, a label, aria-label or aria-labelledby; placeholder text and title attributes do not count.

detect.static: Compute the accessible name per accname 1.2; empty is a failure.

rules.fix: Add visible text, a <label>, or aria-label for icon-only controls.

rules.title: No literal values
rules.statement: Component styles read token roles only, through the binding's custom properties; no literal colours, radii, shadows, durations or z-indexes (`#7c3aed`, `oklch(…)`, `border-radius: 12px`, `z-index: 50`, `300ms`).
rules.rationale: Tokens are the primer; the component is the finish. A literal value breaks every theme at once.

detect.static: A declaration on a component part sets colour, radius, shadow, duration or z-index to anything other than `var(--lq-…)` (or a utility class that does not resolve to a role through the binding).

rules.fix: Replace with the role's custom property from the binding (see spec/bindings/html.yaml).

rules.title: Consume only declared roles
rules.statement: An implementation consumes only the token roles its spec declares under tokens.consumes, or roles declared by entries it reuses.

detect.static: Map the custom properties (or utility classes) the implementation reads back to roles via the binding and diff against the spec.

rules.fix: Either add the role to the spec (and justify it) or drop it from the code.

rules.title: Parts are addressable
rules.statement: Every anatomy part renders with `data-slot="<part>"` so docs, tests and the grader can target it without classes.

detect.static: For each anatomy part marked required, an element with that data-slot exists.

rules.fix: Add data-slot to the part's root element.

rules.title: Reduced motion is honoured
rules.statement: Any transition longer than 150 ms or any looping animation has a `prefers-reduced-motion` branch that removes movement (opacity-only is fine).

detect.static: Animation/transition utilities present without a motion-reduce: variant or media query.
detect.runtime: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion and assert no transform-based animation is running.

rules.fix: Add `motion-reduce:transition-none` / `motion-reduce:animate-none` or an equivalent media query.

rules.title: Three states for every list
rules.statement: Every list, table and search result region has a designed loading (skeleton), empty and error state; "nothing yet" and "no matches" are distinguished.

detect.static: The component accepts or renders a loading, empty and error branch.
detect.runtime: Drive the data source to each condition and assert distinct rendered output.

rules.fix: Add Skeleton, Empty State and an inline error with retry.

rules.title: No stacked modals
rules.statement: A modal dialog never opens another modal dialog; use a step inside the same dialog, a drawer, or a non-modal popover.

detect.runtime: Two elements with role=dialog and aria-modal=true are open at once.

rules.fix: Flatten into a stepper inside one dialog, or convert the inner one to non-modal.

rules.title: Labels are verb-first and specific
rules.statement: Action labels start with a verb and name the object ("Save changes", "Delete 3 files"); never "OK", "Yes", "Submit" or "Click here" when a specific label is possible.

detect.static: Button/menu-item text matches a stoplist or lacks a verb.

rules.fix: Rewrite as verb + object, sentence case, ≤3 words where possible.

rules.title: Render from state, not content
rules.statement: The card's visual state is driven by the `state` prop from the tool lifecycle; it is never inferred from the output text (e.g. "contains 'error'" or "ends with ```").

detect.static: No string matching on output/input in the state logic.

rules.fix: Consume the machine's state; see message-state-machine.

rules.title: Error and approval auto-expand; everything else collapses
rules.statement: output-error and approval-requested open the body automatically; all other states are collapsed by default with a one-line summary visible.

detect.runtime: For each state, assert the body's visibility matches the rule.

rules.fix: Derive `open` from state unless the user has toggled it.

rules.title: Never render model HTML
rules.statement: Output is JSON, text, or a component registered by the product; a string from the model is never set as innerHTML.

detect.static: dangerouslySetInnerHTML / v-html / innerHTML inside the output part.

rules.fix: Render text, or map the tool name to a registered component.

rules.title: Group repeats
rules.statement: Three or more consecutive calls to the same tool collapse into one grouped card ("Searched 4 sources") with the individual calls inside.

detect.static: A grouping step exists before render.

rules.fix: Group by tool name in the message renderer.

rules.title: One lifecycle, consumed everywhere
rules.statement: Every AI component's visual state is a pure function of the thread status or a tool part's state; no component inspects message text to decide how to render.

detect.static: No regex/includes/endsWith on message content in render logic across the implementation.

rules.fix: Pass the status down; see tool-call-card for the shape.

rules.title: Stop in every non-idle state, Regenerate in every terminal state
rules.statement: Stop is wired while status is submitted, streaming:* or awaiting-approval; Regenerate and Edit-and-resend are wired in complete, error and cancelled.

detect.runtime: Drive each state and assert the control is present and enabled.

rules.fix: Derive the composer's primary control from status.

rules.title: Cancel keeps the partial
rules.statement: Stopping a stream keeps the partial output on screen, marked as stopped; it is never cleared.

detect.runtime: Stop mid-stream; the message body is non-empty and carries data-state="cancelled".

rules.fix: Transition to cancelled, do not reset the message.

rules.title: Never a div with onClick
rules.statement: A button is a native `<button>`; a `div`, `span` or `a` without `href` carrying a click handler is a defect.
rules.rationale: Keyboard activation, focus order, form submission and the accessible role all come free from the element; recreating them is never complete.

detect.static: div|span[onClick] without role=button, or any element with role=button that is not <button>.
detect.runtime: Press Enter and Space on the focused control; both must activate.

rules.fix: Replace with `<button type="button">` and keep the classes.

rules.title: Loading keeps width and blocks re-press
rules.statement: While loading, the button keeps its enabled width, shows an in-place spinner, sets aria-busy="true" and ignores further presses.

detect.static: loading branch renders a spinner inside the button and sets aria-busy.
detect.runtime: Measure width before and during loading; press twice; the handler fires once.

rules.fix: Reserve the icon slot for the spinner and gate the press handler on `loading`.

rules.title: One primary per view
rules.statement: A view (page, dialog, drawer, card) shows at most one primary-emphasis button.

detect.static: Count [data-emphasis="primary"] within each dialog/main/section landmark.

rules.fix: Demote the others to secondary or tertiary; if two actions are equally important, neither is primary.

rules.title: No navigation disguised as a button
rules.statement: A button never calls router.push / location.assign as its only effect; a Link styled as a button does that.

detect.static: press handler body is a navigation call.

rules.fix: Use `<Link emphasis="primary">` (link rendered with button styles) so middle-click, copy-link and prefetch work.

rules.title: Icon-only needs a name
rules.statement: A button whose only child is an icon has no accessible name and is a defect; use icon-button with aria-label.

detect.static: Accessible name computes to empty.

rules.fix: Switch to icon-button, or add visible text.

rules.title: No disabled submit as validation
rules.statement: Do not hard-disable a submit button to signal an invalid form; let the user press it and show the errors (LQ-ERR-01 pattern). Soft-disable with an explanation is acceptable for truly unavailable actions.

detect.static: submit button `disabled` bound to form validity.

rules.fix: Keep the button enabled; validate on submit; focus the first invalid field.

rules.title: Focus in, focus back
rules.statement: Opening moves focus inside the dialog; closing returns focus to the trigger.

detect.runtime: document.activeElement is inside the dialog after open and equals the trigger after close.

rules.fix: Use the native <dialog>.showModal() or the renderer's focus-scope primitive; store the trigger on open.

rules.title: Background is inert
rules.statement: While a modal dialog is open, content outside it is inert (not focusable, not clickable, hidden from assistive tech).

detect.runtime: Tab from the last focusable inside wraps to the first; outside elements are not reachable.

rules.fix: Use <dialog>.showModal() or set `inert` on siblings of the portal root.

rules.title: Never an unlabeled dialog
rules.statement: Every dialog has a visible title referenced by aria-labelledby; a visually-hidden title is acceptable only for full-screen media viewers.

detect.static: role=dialog without aria-labelledby, or the referenced element is empty.

rules.fix: Add a Title part.

rules.title: Destructive confirms default to safety
rules.statement: When the primary action is destructive, initial focus and the default (Enter) action are the non-destructive option, and scrim-click does not close.

detect.runtime: On open, activeElement is the cancel button when a destructive button is present.

rules.fix: Set initialFocus to the cancel action and dismissible=false.
